function.description: Raw read-only eth_call against a contract. Returns the raw hex; any decoding is best-effort and unverified. No state change.
function.name: defi_data_contract_read

address.description: Contract address to read from (0x…). EVM chains only — there is no eth_call on solana.

chain.description: Chain to read from — the same address is a DIFFERENT token on a different chain, so name it deliberately. Readable: ethereum, base, robinhood, robinhood-testnet, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, solana.
